**Verdict: PASS.** The round-13 finding F-DG2-480 is fixed, and I raised no new findings.

- **Candidate:** `sha256:9f3ca298…b684e` (560 files). I recomputed it before and after my runs and it matched each time.
- **Commits:** source `ea9051b2`, frozen at `d99de987`.
- **DG1 historical check:** passes.

## F-DG2-480 (High) is now CLOSED_VERIFIED
In round 13, when a session ended while the app was open, the page looped between sign-in and the app at about 130 sign-in-status checks per second (`/me`). Under the default rate limits that also locked out every sign-in from the same IP. On this candidate:
- **My round-13 probes now pass unchanged**, in English and Arabic, with both raised and default rate limits. That includes the refused-upload case: the user lands on sign-in with the localized message, nothing is stored, and signing in again returns them to the evidence page.
- **New probe with five ways a session can end:** sign-out in a real second tab, an administrator revoking access, idle expiry, absolute expiry, and logout through the API. Each passed 31/31 under raised limits and 31/31 under default limits.
  - The user is sent to the sign-in page exactly once, with the form and the "session ended" message in the right language and direction.
  - Each trigger made 1 `/me` request in 10 s and got no "too many requests" (429) responses.
  - No stale signed-in screen appeared.
  - A second browser from the same IP can still sign in, and signing in again returns the user to their page.
- **One limit, not a defect:** a tab only learns its session ended from its next request to the server. A page served entirely from cache stays visible until then.

## FE11 / FE12 language changes (English and Arabic)
- **Language not saved:** when saving the language to the profile fails, the chosen language stays on screen. The notice appears in that language, both English→Arabic and Arabic→English.
- **Header:** the notice sits below the header at 320, 768 and 1280 px, the header height and wordmark width don't change, and nothing overflows sideways.
- **Live re-translation:** these messages switch language and direction while visible: the dev sign-in errors, the Team "Role assigned" notice and the journey-steps error.
  - The language button can't be clicked while the steps editor dialog is open, which is normal for a dialog. For that case my probe triggered the switch directly instead of clicking.

## Full re-review
- **Faithfulness to the playbook (26 requirements):** a direct comparison against B0009, B0018, B0023, B0029, B0035, B0037, B0039–B0043, B0056 and B0062 passed 24/24.
- **Live walk-through** on a throwaway database with synthetic data:
  - Diagnose → Define → Design with G1, G2 and G3 decided in order; out-of-order submissions are refused (422) and the submitter can't decide.
  - G2 is blocked with zero guardrails, and there is exactly one current North Star.
  - Arabic charter text with RLM marks is stored exactly as entered.
  - A value made only of invisible characters is refused with the localized message in English and Arabic.
  - An uploaded evidence file downloads unchanged.
- **Invariants still hold:**
  - the brand is provisional, with no claim of PMI or Mobily certification;
  - money is stored as decimals;
  - unquantified value pools are labelled and their amount is empty, not 0;
  - product gates are G1–G6 only and separate from DG0–DG7.
- **Build checks:** typecheck, build, lint, tests (848/848) and the contrast check pass on Node 22 and Node 24.

## Failed attempts and things to know
- **Failed attempts:** every failed attempt was a mistake in my own probes, not the product. All are kept and explained in `env.txt`:
  - a page served from cache made no request;
  - an expiry step also expired my probe's own session;
  - a language preference was left over from an earlier probe;
  - my sign-ins exceeded the 20-per-minute limit, fixed by pacing;
  - the stack's shutdown script exited 1 after the shutdown probe.
- **Environmental residuals:** the live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049) are recorded as PASS on the offline/config surface, as instructed. Keycloak sign-in was not exercised live.
- **Handback location:** the write guard refused the assigned handback path, as in rounds 12 and 13, so the handback is in my evidence folder instead. The assignment and the write permissions still contradict each other.
- **HEAD moved during my run:** HEAD moved to the code-security reviewer's auto-committed evidence (`64e2082`). The candidate ID is unchanged, and I did not read their record.
